facts.statement: The genus Crocodilaemus was described by Jourdan in 1857.
The type species of the genus is C. robustus.
Fossils of Crocodilaemus date to the Late Jurassic period.
Fossils of Crocodilaemus have been found at the Cerin Lagerstätte in eastern France and date to the late Kimmeridgian age.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found from the Cerin Lagerstätte of eastern France and are of late Kimmeridgian age.

facts.statement: The environment where Crocodilaemus fossils were found is thought to have been the bottom of a lagoon enclosed by an emergent reef complex.
facts.quote: The depositional environment in Cerin at the time is thought to have been the bottom of a lagoon that was enclosed by an emergent reef complex

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database lists the parent group of Crocodilaemus as Teleosauridae.
Crocodilaemus is classified within the family Teleosauridae.
Crocodilaemus belongs to the class Reptilia.

rejected.statement: Crocodilaemus is an extinct genus of pholidosaurid mesoeucrocodylian.
rejected.quote: Crocodilaemus is an extinct genus of pholidosaurid mesoeucrocodylian.
